description: Checks every crates.io package in a Cargo.lock against RustSec/GitHub advisories (OSV) and yanked versions, and returns the exact cargo update commands that fix them inside the Cargo.toml requirements, plus what needs a manual bump. Needs api_key; without one, POST to https://api.tensorust.com/v1/audit/cargo-lock and pay $0.05 over HTTP 402.

api_key.description: Your Tensorust Data API key (tdk_...), Pro or Business, from https://shop.tensorust.com/dev/data-api

name: audit_cargo_lock
title: Audit a Cargo.lock and get the fix (key)
